title: 'What did you just change?' now gets a real answer
why: 12 s: it quoted my last request, said 95.55 s → 78.41 s and admitted that is 3 s over the target, then listed per shot what moved and why. Last round it said it had no history. This is the thing that makes directing by words possible.

title: The wobble: it looked (and said so while waiting), found no wobble at 0:40, and told me what IS there, with times that are true
why: 'at about 0:40 there is a wobble, lose it' → 35 s, wait line 'Looking at shots 8-10 (0:35.0–0:46.0): 45 frames · cutting 4/45 … reading them'. Answer: no wobble at 0:40, that's the rider balancing on the ridge; nearest real shake is a face swinging across the lens at 0:38.2 and a tilted car-park frame at 0:38.8; offered a 0.7 s trim. I checked 0:37.12, 0:38.05, 0:38.19, 0:40, 0:42: all three claims true. Last round it invented a jump cut 'after the wobble'.

title: 'Cut every bit where the camera points at the ground or the sky' now works by words
why: 35 s; the wait said 'Looking at every shot in the cut, about a frame a second: 90 frames · cutting 4/90 … reading them'. It found one spot (end of shot 4, a lap and a yellow chair seat, 0:18.2-0:19.1), trimmed 1.2 s, said nowhere points at the sky, and was honest that at 1 fps the tip-down starts 'somewhere between those two frames'. My own contact sheet every 3 s of the cut agrees. Round 1 it refused and asked me to scrub and drop markers.

title: Sideways shot fixed by one sentence
why: 'the airport bar shot plays sideways in the monitor, fix it' → 22 s, it looked at 4 frames, said the source is upright and the -90° rotation is what turns it, proposed rotation 0 + scale 100 with an 'After' preview; accepted, plays upright.

title: Title 'Copper 2026' clean on the first try, one Accept, and it caught its own overflow
why: ~45 s after one Accept: centred white 'Copper 2026' on a soft plate over the ridge drop, fading in and out, fully inside the frame (checked 0:00.06–0:04.12). The wait line showed it checking the frame and re-asking the designer when the words ran outside. Last round it shipped 'PER 2026' marked ✓ checked.
